Ayam own new theorem and model
A good way to create something genuinely novel is to propose a research architecture rather than claim a new state-of-the-art model. Here's a conceptual design.

AyamGNN: Adaptive Graph Neural Network (Concept)

Status: Research concept (not an existing or validated model).

Goal

AyamGNN is designed for:

Knowledge graphs

Molecular property prediction

Power-grid analysis

Financial transaction networks

Multi-agent systems

Robotics


Core Architecture

Input Graph
      │
Node Encoder
      │
Edge Encoder
      │
Adaptive Graph Attention
      │
Dynamic Message Passing
      │
Hierarchical Graph Pooling
      │
Global Memory Layer
      │
Prediction Head

Layer Update

For node \(i\):

\[
h_i^{(l+1)}
=
\sigma\!\left(
W_1h_i^{(l)}
+
\sum_{j\in\mathcal N(i)}
\alpha_{ij}W_2h_j^{(l)}
+
M^{(l)}
\right)
\]

where:

\(h_i^{(l)}\) = node embedding

\(\alpha_{ij}\) = learned attention weight

\(M^{(l)}\) = global graph memory

\(W_1, W_2\) = trainable matrices


Novel Research Ideas

Instead of standard GNN message passing alone, AyamGNN could investigate:

Adaptive memory that stores long-range graph information.

Temporal graph updates for evolving networks.

Physics-aware constraints for engineering applications.

Multi-scale pooling to capture both local and global graph structure.

Uncertainty estimation for predictions.


Example Applications

Drug discovery using molecular graphs

Electrical grid fault prediction

Fraud detection in banking networks

Protein interaction analysis

Transportation and logistics optimization

Social network analytics

Python

[Deep Graph Library (DGL)](https://www.dgl.ai?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

CUDA for GPU acceleration


Future Variants

AyamGNN-T — Temporal graph networks

AyamGNN-Mol — Molecular chemistry

AyamGNN-Grid — Smart power systems

AyamGNN-Vision — Vision graphs

AyamGNN-MoE — Mixture-of-experts graph model
